criteria: `slugify(title)` keeps its existing behaviour: the title is lower-cased, accented letters lose their accents (`é` becomes `e`), every run of characters other than `a`-`z` and `0`-`9` becomes one hyphen, and hyphens at the start and the end are removed.
`slugify(title)` returns `"untitled"` for a title that leaves nothing.
`slugify` accepts a `max_length` parameter with default `None`, as `slugify(title, max_length=None)`.
Rule 1: `slugify` with `max_length=None` gives the same result as today.

Rule 2: a slug is a list of words joined by hyphens; when the slug is longer than `max_length`, `slugify` shortens it to the longest run of whole leading words that fits in `max_length` characters. `slugify("the quick brown fox", 12)` is `"the-quick"`, because `"the-quick-br"` would cut a word.
Rule 3: when the first word alone is longer than `max_length`, `slugify` cuts that word to exactly `max_length` characters: `slugify("extraordinary", 5)` is `"extra"`.
Rule 4: the result of `slugify` never starts or ends with a hyphen and is never longer than `max_length`.
Rule 5: `slugify` shortens `"untitled"` by the same rule: `slugify("!!!", 3)` is `"unt"`.
Rule 6: `slugify` with `max_length` below 1 raises `ValueError`.
A new function `unique_slug(title, taken, max_length=None)` exists in `slug.py`.
Rule 7: `unique_slug` accepts as `taken` any collection of slugs that are in use (a list, a set or a tuple), and does not change `taken`.
Rule 8: when `slugify(title, max_length)` is not in `taken`, `unique_slug` returns that slug.

Rule 9: otherwise `unique_slug` returns the base slug with a suffix, trying `-2`, then `-3`, and so on, and the first one that is not in `taken` wins. `unique_slug("Hello", ["hello", "hello-2"])` is `"hello-3"`.

Rule 10: with `max_length`, the whole result of `unique_slug`, suffix included, is at most `max_length` characters; the base is shortened by rules 2 to 4 to `max_length` minus the length of the suffix, and this is done again for each suffix tried (because `-10` is longer than `-9`). `unique_slug("the quick brown", {"the-quick"}, 12)` is `"the-quick-2"`, and with `max_length=10` it is `"the-2"`.
Rule 11: `unique_slug` raises `ValueError` when a suffix leaves less than one character for the base.
